title: Spring Kickoff Ride
blurb: Shake off the winter rust with our annual spring opener. All paces welcome — we regroup at every junction so no one gets left behind.

title: Flat Tire Clinic
blurb: Learn how to change a tube and patch a flat in under five minutes. We'll cover road, gravel, and tubeless setups. Free for all skill levels.

title: Twilight Trail Ride
blurb: An evening spin on the local forest trails as the sun goes down. Lights required. A great way to wind down the week with good company.

title: Kids Bike Safety Day
blurb: Bring the little ones for a fun morning of bike safety tips, helmet checks, and a short guided ride around the parking lot course.

title: Gravel Grinder 50
blurb: A challenging 50-mile gravel loop through the coast range foothills. Intermediate to advanced riders. Sag support provided at mile 25.
